welcome: On behalf of the Organizing Committee, we are pleased to welcome researchers, academics, clinicians, engineers, industry professionals, and students to the 14th Asian-Pacific Conference on Biomechanics (14th APBiomech), to be held in Bali, Indonesia, on November 16–19, 2027.

Hosted by Institut Teknologi Bandung, the conference aims to provide an international platform for presenting advances in biomechanics, exchanging scientific knowledge, and fostering interdisciplinary collaboration across the Asia-Pacific region and beyond.
We look forward to welcoming the biomechanics community to Indonesia for an inspiring scientific and cultural experience.
